templates.name: Spring Boot Jar
templates.description: 单个可执行 jar，nohup 启动、PID 文件判活、自动探测端口

hooks.start:
set -e
cd "$PROJECT_PATH"
JAR=$(ls -1 *.jar 2>/dev/null | head -n1)
if [ -z "$JAR" ]; then echo "no jar found in $PROJECT_PATH"; exit 2; fi
PID=$(cat "$JPOM_PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then echo "already running: $PID"; exit 0; fi
setsid sh -c 'echo $$ > "$JPOM_PID_FILE"; exec "{{javaBin}}" {{jvm}} -DJpom.application.ssh="$PROJECT_ID" -DJpom.basedir="$PROJECT_PATH" -jar "$JAR" {{args}} >> "$JPOM_LOG_FILE" 2>&1' < /dev/null > /dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 1
PID=$(cat "$JPOM_PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then echo "started: $PID"; else echo "start failed"; exit 3; fi
hooks.status:
PID=$(cat "$JPOM_PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
  if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PORT=$(ss -lntp 2>/dev/null | grep -F "pid=$PID," | awk '{print $4}' | awk -F: '{print $NF}' | sort -n | head -n1)
  else
    PORT=$(netstat -lntp 2>/dev/null | grep -F "$PID/" | awk '{print $4}' | awk -F: '{print $NF}' | sort -n | head -n1)
  fi
  if [ -n "$PORT" ]; then echo "running:$PID:$PORT"; else echo "running:$PID"; fi
else
  echo stopped
fi
hooks.stop:
PID=$(cat "$JPOM_PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$PID" ]; then echo "no pid file"; exit 0; fi
kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do
  if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then rm -f "$JPOM_PID_FILE"; echo stopped; exit 0; fi
  sleep 1; i=$((i+1))
done
kill -9 "$PID" 2>/dev/null
rm -f "$JPOM_PID_FILE"
echo stopped

templates.name: Docker Compose
templates.description: compose 文件管理服务，up/down 映射启动停止，按运行容器数判活

hooks.start:
cd "$PROJECT_PATH"
docker compose -f {{composeFile}} up -d
echo "compose up done"
hooks.status:
cd "$PROJECT_PATH"
COUNT=$(docker compose -f {{composeFile}} ps --status running -q 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " ")
if [ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then echo "running:0"; else echo stopped; fi
hooks.stop:
cd "$PROJECT_PATH"
docker compose -f {{composeFile}} down
echo stopped

templates.name: systemd 服务
templates.description: 托管给 systemd 的服务，start/stop/is-active 映射生命周期（守护由 systemd 负责）

hooks.status:
STATUS=$(systemctl is-active {{unitName}} 2>/dev/null)
if [ "$STATUS" = "active" ]; then echo "running:0"; else echo stopped; fi

templates.name: Nginx 静态站
templates.description: 管理已有 nginx 配置的 reload/停止，配置校验失败会直接报错

hooks.start:
set -e
"{{nginxBin}}" -t -c "{{confPath}}"
if pgrep -f "nginx: master process" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  "{{nginxBin}}" -c "{{confPath}}" -s reload
else
  "{{nginxBin}}" -c "{{confPath}}"
fi
sleep 1
if pgrep -f "nginx: master process" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "started: 0"; else echo "start failed"; exit 3; fi
hooks.status: if pgrep -f "nginx: master process" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "running:0"; else echo stopped; fi
